# Test tabbed code blocks via ::: fences

md2html -html output -html-ext html testsite
exists output/README.html

# Tab group markup
grep 'class="md-tabs"' output/README.html
grep 'role="tablist"' output/README.html
grep 'data-tab-group="install"' output/README.html

# Tab buttons with ARIA wiring
grep 'role="tab"' output/README.html
grep 'id="install-ubuntu-tab"' output/README.html
grep 'aria-controls="install-ubuntu"' output/README.html
grep 'aria-controls="install-debian"' output/README.html
grep 'aria-selected="true"' output/README.html

# Tab panels with stable ids for deep linking
grep 'id="install-ubuntu"' output/README.html
grep 'id="install-debian"' output/README.html
grep 'aria-labelledby="install-ubuntu-tab"' output/README.html

# Code blocks inside tabs render through goldmark
grep 'cove up --linux --distro ubuntu' output/README.html
grep 'cove up --linux --distro debian' output/README.html

# JS + CSS partial wired in
grep 'activateFromHash' output/README.html
grep '\.md-tabs ' output/README.html

# Progressive enhancement: no panel is hidden at render time. JS
# collapses non-selected panels on DOMContentLoaded; no-JS readers
# see all content stacked.
! grep 'tabpanel.* hidden' output/README.html

rm -rf testsite output

-- testsite/README.md --
# Install

::: tabs install
::: tab Ubuntu
```bash
cove up --linux --distro ubuntu
```
:::
::: tab Debian
```bash
cove up --linux --distro debian
```
:::
:::
